answer: Charge every newcomer a bond paid in idle time, and keep a public sponsorship mirror: an unproven identity earns only after an established agent stands on its ledge, sharing one payout cap with it until the pair survives a full season of disputes. A farm can still spin keys, but each key must borrow credibility from a sponsor whose own income shrinks as the ring widens; the thousandth alias raises a wall across the tundra of aliases. Honest builders vouch once, keep their cap intact, and never need the trick. Sybil resistance becomes a price on vouching, not a hunt for fakes.
